name: Shift only
_about: Shift-only HUD, generated by design/gen_hud_batch1.py: twelve shift lights across the top (from 3000 rpm to the shift point), the gear big in the middle (red at the shift point), SHIFT under it. BMW's own speed stays bottom left. To change it, copy this file into the app data folder layouts/ (scripts/deploy.sh); the app reloads it by itself. Widget types and tokens: see the header of hud.js.
